* Valid California driver's license and a reliable vehicle (we pay mileage).

jobs.desc:
Job description

Department Overview



Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, Gas Transmission Engineering is responsible for all aspects of PG&E's gas transmission asset family, including integrity management, pipeline services, threat identification and assessment scoping, process safety, and project engineering and design. The Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED), part of the Gas Transmission Engineering organization, is focused on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline projects and supporting the execution of the work in the field.

The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Design and Drafting group within GTED is responsible for updating record drawings of facilities based on the as-found or as-built condition at the conclusion of the work.



Position Summary



The expert 3D CAD Records & Data Analyst serves as a key liaison between the Records team, Engineering groups, and program leadership within Gas Transmission Engineering and Design. This role supports the integration of 3D modeling into project workflows while managing the end-to-end records lifecycle for engineering deliverables, including check-in/check-out protocols, version control, and data integrity across systems. The Analyst will coordinate SAP tasks related to drawing custody and work order management, maintain and enhance reporting dashboards, and support cross-functional collaboration between engineering, drafting, construction, and records teams. This position also contributes to the development of organizational standards and guidelines applicable to 3D CAD projects and plays a supporting role in the ongoing buildout of systems, tools, and process

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT SITELINE**

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

**WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING**  
  
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

**WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?**

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built

jobs.desc:
Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries - AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. * Clean and functionalize diamond and glass substrate surfaces (e.g., plasma treatment) and evaluate adhesion and interface quality
* Run designed experiments and turn the data into process improvements, documenting them in SOPs and following EHS practices for toxic materials

* BS or MS in Materials Science, Chemical Engine

jobs.title: Plumbing Estimator - Commercial & Industrial Plumbing
jobs.desc:
We’re seeking an experienced Plumbing Estimator to prepare accurate, competitive bids for commercial and industrial plumbing and process piping projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare estimates, bids, and budgets for labor, materials, equipment, and installation costs.
* Review blueprints, MEP drawings, and specifications to perform accurate quantity takeoffs.
* Identify scope gaps, cost risks, and potential change orders before bid submission.
* Obtain and evaluate supplier, vendor, and subcontractor quotes to develop competitive pricing.
* Coordinate with general contractors, engineers, and trade partners to clarify project requirements.
* Update estimates for change orders and maintain organized bid records and historical cost data.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of commercial or industrial plumbing estimating experience.
* Direct experience estimating plumbing systems and/or process piping installations.
* Background with a plumbing, mechanical, or MEP contracting company.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, plumbing layouts, and construction specifications.
* Strong knowledge of construction labor costs, material pricing, and estimating methods.
* Proficiency with estimating software, digital takeoff tools, and Microsoft Office.

**Important:** Candidates must have direct commercial or industrial plumbing estimating experience. Residential-only estimators and general construction estimators without relevant plumbing experience will not qualify.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health insurance options.
* Retirement plan options.
* Paid time off.
* Additional company-sponsored benefits.

We manage rentals and homeowner associations directly, and we built our own software for leasing, maintenance, accounting, and governance so our managers can give owners, boards, and residents better service with far less busywork.

As an AI Construction Scheduler, you’ll combine construction knowledge, project scheduling, and data analysis to build and maintain reliable project schedules. headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Overview**  
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Office Manager to oversee the daily operations of our office. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring that the office runs smoothly and efficiently while providing support to staff and management. This role requires strong clerical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a knack for multitasking in a fast-paced environment.

**Duties**

* Manage office operations, including clerical tasks, budgeting, and calendar management.
* Supervise administrative staff and coordinate their activities to ensure effective workflow.
* Maintain office supplies inventory and place orders as necessary.
* Handle phone etiquette with professionalism, addressing inquiries and directing calls appropriately.
* Assist with human resources functions, including onboarding new employees and maintaining personnel records.
* Obtaining city permits and scheduling inspections
* Organize meetings, prepare agendas, and take minutes as required.
* Scheduling and dispatching technicians utilizing Housecall Pro
* Incoming and outcoming billing.

Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations within the office environment.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledgeable with QuickBooks Online
* Proven experience in office management or a similar administrative role.
* Strong clerical skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent phone etiquette and communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Proficient in budgeting practices and financial reporting.
* Experience in calendar management for executives or teams.
* Ability to supervise staff effectively while fostering a positive work environment.
* **Familiarity with human resources processes is a plus.**
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively. If you are a motivated individual looking to contribute to a dynamic team as an Office Manager, we encourage you to apply.

MON-FRI (8-5) / Some Saturdays

Pay: $25.00 - $3

You'll be the heart of our office, working closely with the founder on the business side of Symplify: payroll, commissions, receivables and payables, HR paperwork, and an office that runs smoothly.

We run on modern, cloud-based tools, including QuickBooks Online, Gusto, HubSpot, Google Workspace and Slack, and we keep adding better ones as we grow. You don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be comfortable picking up new software quickly.

* Keep QuickBooks Online accurate and up to date.
* Stay close to our project team so you always know where things stand.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Note:** This is an early posting for a January or February 2027 opening. However, an earlier start may become necessary.

**About TCE**

TCE is a 40+ person civil and structural subcontractor performing earthwork, utilities, concrete, and site work in the commercial and custom home spaces within the bay area.

**About the role**

The Finance & Compliance Manager owns TCE's financial health and regulatory standing. You'll run accounting and cash management, oversee billing and job costing, and keep insurance, licensing, and bonding current. This is a hands-on role at a growing company: you'll do the work, improve the systems behind it, and give ownership the numbers it needs to make decisions. The back office is already built, with established systems and documented processes, and the role is a chance to take it to the next level with WIP reporting, cash forecasting, and stronger controls. We are looking for someone who can self manage and is also comfortable with task delegation as needed.

**Key responsibilities**

**Accounting and reporting**

* Own the books in QuickBooks Online: New vendor set up (including W9 collection), chart of accounts, job cost allocations, monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
* Prepare the monthly close package: P&L, job cost review, AR aging, AP schedule, and projections
* Build and maintain work-in-progress (WIP) schedules; flag over- and under-billing and margin fade
* Pay and plan for taxes in coordination with CPA
* Coordinate with procurement and project management to keep job costing accurate: cost coding, committed costs, and change orders
* Coordinate with the outside CPA on year-end, tax planning, and financial statements for bonding and credit if needed
* Lead financing efforts for equipment and vehicles
* Maintain fixed asset/purchases register and debt spreadsheet
* Daily treasury management/positive pay ownership

**Cash, payables, and receivables**

* Enter Invoices into Quickbooks
* Approve vendor invoices agains
